title: Paris nunciature (Girolamo Ragazzoni, bishop of Bergamo) to the Secretariat, 3 March 1586 (ASV Segr. Stato Francia 18/2; DECODE R16; R15 deciphered by Lasry)

steps.what: Fetched DECODE R11-R17 record pages and DOC_ files with the session cookie.
Found R16's decryption file byte-identical to R15's (md5), so R16 was never decrypted.
Applied Lasry's F18 key to the DECODE transcription of R16: 1,410 pairs, 66 unknown, readable Italian on the 1586 alienation bull.
Meister p. 324 no. 2 (Ragazzoni 1583 key with nomenclator) from OCR; realigned and added to the R16 decoder with a one-digit resync.
Split under the one-key rule: R17 (Meister no. 40, Morosini's key) moved to morosini1588 with its transcription and decryption; this entry keeps R16 in the F18 key.

outcome.method_basis: R16 was read with Lasry's F18 key filed on the R15/R16 DECODE records (D3103/D3105); its nomenclator was added from Meister p. 324 no. 2 (Ragazzoni's 1583 Paris key); R15 had already been read by Lasry (2020).
outcome.fraction_read_source: R16_decryption.txt (scratchpad measure_A_units.py, 21 Sept 2026): units = plaintext letters (one per cipher pair) + one per bracketed code/name group; unread = every <..> group (unresolved codes and slips, 43 of 1,681). R15 (Lasry) not counted. R17 (0.998) moved to morosini1588 on 14 Oct 2026.
outcome.notes: R15 read before (Lasry); R16 read here, names 18/48 unconfirmed. Measured 21 Sept 2026: R16 0.974 of units read; codes_open = R16 codes 18 and 48 (the other <..> groups are mostly transcription slips). R17 was split off to morosini1588 on 14 Oct 2026 (Meister no. 40, a different key).

gaps.detail: Meister's Ferrara/Parma values do not fit the contexts; the 1586 table may have moved them
unknowns after the one-digit resync; mostly transcription slips in TimB transcription D1610, images not re-read

credits.note: F18 key (DECODE D3103/D3105) and his R15 decryption (D3102); R16 read with the key

credits.source: A. Meister, Die Geheimschrift im Dienste der päpstlichen Kurie (1906) p. 324

prior.where: F18 key and an R15 decryption on DECODE (Lasry 2020); no R16 decryption

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
